name: PA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Rabb heavily outspends token independent opposition
Open seat removes incumbency but not the partisan baseline
model.rationale: Philadelphia-based PA-03 is one of the most Democratic districts in the country, and the only serious candidate, Chris Rabb, has raised over $1.3 million with substantial outside support against an independent rival who raised about $10,800. Markets price a Democratic win near certainty, consistent with the fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise primary upset or an unexpectedly competitive independent campaign would be the only realistic path to narrowing this margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Dwight Evans (D) is not on the ballot.
Dennis Mahoney is an independent standing in for the Republican side.

overview:
This open Philadelphia-area House seat is among the most Democratic-leaning districts in the nation, with a partisan lean of roughly D+40. Dwight Evans is retiring, leaving state Rep. Chris Rabb as the Democratic nominee facing independent Dennis Mahoney, who has raised only about $10,800.

Rabb has raised over $1.3 million and benefits from roughly $1.6 million in outside support, while prediction markets put his win probability around 96%. With no competitive opposition and no polling suggesting otherwise, the seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands.
